typography.font_install_instructions: Import Outfit and Manrope from Google Fonts. DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-none

colors.archetype: Electric & Neon Tech (Modified for Fintech Trust)
rules: Never use pure black (#000000). Always use tinted dark blue-grey (#06080D).
Use #00E5FF (Cyan) for primary CTAs and interactive states.
Ensure all text meets minimum 4.5:1 contrast against dark backgrounds.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for sticky headers, floating navs, and modal overlays. Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#06080D]/60 with a 1px inner border of border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.textures: Apply subtle noise/grain texture overlay (opacity-20) to the main background of the landing page to break flat digital feel.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Use soft, diffuse ambient shadows for elevated elements: shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)].
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose grid borders in dashboards. Items should have border-r border-b border-white/5 to create a technical, data-rich look.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) or sharp slightly-rounded (rounded-md) for dashboard. Apply hover:bg-cyan-400 hover:text-black transition-colors.
components.cards: For marketing: use glassmorphism with asymmetric layouts. For dashboard: flat surface (#0D111C) with rounded-lg, 1px border-white/10, no heavy shadow.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form components. Inputs should have bg-transparent or elevated surface background with distinct focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-500).
components.tables: Dense rows (h-12), left-align text, right-align numbers. Hover states on rows with bg-white/5.
components.charts: Use Recharts with dark-mode specific semantic colors (cyan for wallet balances, green/red for commission trends).
components.navigation: Sticky top header with glassmorphism on landing. Left sidebar on dashboard with collapsed/expanded states.

grids.marketing_bento: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Create asymmetric bento grids (e.g., col-span-8 row-span-2 for hero feature, col-span-4 for secondary).
grids.dashboard_density: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Summary cards take col-span-1. Charts take col-span-3. Lists take col-span-1.

layouts.landing_page: Hero section with large typographic overlay, asymmetric feature bento grid, dark textured background, floating glass header.
layouts.dashboard_container: Flex row layout. Fixed sidebar (w-64) + main content area (flex-1). Main content area needs p-6 or p-8.

roles.admin: Focus on high-level system metrics, table-heavy views for user management.
roles.master_distributor: Focus on downline charts and aggregate commissions.
roles.distributor: Focus on retailer network and wallet transfers.
roles.retailer: Action-oriented layout: Large Recharge form (mobile, DTH, etc.) in the center, wallet balance fixed prominently.

motion.interactions: All buttons/links must have hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-95 transition-transform.
motion.entrances: Staggered fade-up for dashboard widgets and table rows.
motion.page_transitions: Smooth opacity transition on route changes.

accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus outlines required for all interactive elements.
accessibility.contrast: Always verify APCA contrast. Do not put thin grey text on dark grey backgrounds.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY: Add data-testid attributes to all inputs, buttons, tables, and nav links (e.g., data-testid='login-button', data-testid='recharge-submit').

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react. Duotone weight for marketing, Regular/Bold for dashboard.
media.image_treatment: Images in marketing should have dark overlays (bg-black/40) to blend with the dark theme.

3d_libraries.usage: Optional: Use react-tsparticles for a subtle floating node network background on the landing page or auth screen to represent digital transactions.

image_urls.description: Blue and white light streaks representing fast, digital fintech transactions.
Abstract neon geometric design on dark backdrop for login or sign-up pages.
Hand holding card in front of a computer, used for Recharge/Wallet feature descriptions.
Business people using smartphone, representing the distributor/retailer network.

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Setup React, Tailwind, and Shadcn UI. Import Google Fonts (Outfit, Manrope).
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Define standard Tailwind config with the specified dark color palette (#06080D background).
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Build the marketing landing page using raw HTML/Tailwind for asymmetric bento sections and glassmorphism headers.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Build auth pages (Login/Signup) with Google OAuth buttons.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Build the App Shell (Sidebar + Topbar) for the dashboard.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_6: Implement Role-based dashboard views. Admin (Management), MD/Distributor (Network/Commissions), Retailer (Recharge form).
instructions_to_main_agent.step_7: Integrate data visualization (Recharts) for commission and transaction summaries.
instructions_to_main_agent.rule_check: Ensure no complete transparent backgrounds on dropdowns. Check data-testid tags.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.avoid_ai_slop: Do not make generic centered layouts. Use layered depth, asymmetric bento grids, and z-index hierarchy.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.dark_mode_rules: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients. Add subtle grain textures.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.transitions: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Target specific properties.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.text_alignment: You MUST NOT center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.components: Use sonner for toasts. Customize Shadcn elements (e.g., tablist h-auto instead of fixed h-9).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.icons: Use lucide-react. NEVER use emojis like 🤖, 🧠, 💡 for UI icons.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.placeholders: Missing images must use the provided image_urls. NEVER use placeholder text or dummy image services.

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES.spacing: Use 2-3x more spacing than typical defaults (e.g., p-8 or p-12 for containers) to create premium feel.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES.optical_alignment: Align elements optically (e.g., adjust padding for icons inside buttons so they feel centered visually).
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES.hierarchy: Use size and contrast to establish clear information hierarchy. Do not rely solely on font-weight.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
